meta_description: D Clarke Electrical provides reliable electrical services across Birmingham. NICEIC certified, fast response times, and transparent pricing. Call 07840 155041 today.
hero_subhead: From rewires to fault finding, we diagnose and fix electrical problems fast. Same-day emergency callouts across Birmingham and the surrounding areas.
services_subhead: Whether it's a fault, an upgrade, or a new installation, we handle it with care and precision.

services.title: Emergency Fault Finding
services.desc: Tripped electrics? Flickering lights? We pinpoint the fault fast and fix it on the spot, most jobs completed within hours of your call.

services.title: Rewires & Upgrades
services.desc: Older wiring? We replace outdated systems with modern, safe electrics and can upgrade your consumer unit to meet current Building Regulations.

services.title: New Installations
services.desc: Kitchen circuits, electric showers, EV charging points, and full house installations. All work tested and certified with a completion certificate.

services.title: Sockets, Switches & Lighting
services.desc: Adding outlets, installing new light fittings, or replacing switches. We handle it safely and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Boiler & Central Heating Electrics
services.desc: Electrical work on heating systems, including immersion heaters and electric radiator installation, all Part P compliant.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: EICR testing for rental properties and landlord compliance checks. We provide detailed reports and remedial quotes if needed.

about_pullquote: I work the same way I'd want someone working in my own home.
about_para_1: D Clarke Electrical was established in Birmingham over 18 years ago. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local business, built entirely on reliability and honest pricing. We're NICEIC certified and keep up to date with the latest Building Regulations and industry best practice.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we turn up when we say we will, explain the job clearly, and never overcharge. We carry parts on the van, diagnose faults on the first visit, and leave your home clean. Word of mouth is how we've built our reputation in Birmingham, and we're proud of that.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Fantastic service. Dave came out at 10pm on a Friday night because our electrics kept tripping. Diagnosed a faulty switch in under 10 minutes and fitted a new one. Fair price and very professional. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired by D Clarke. The team were tidy, didn't cause any mess, and explained everything as they went. Finished ahead of schedule too. Brilliant work and excellent value for money.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Our boiler electrics packed in and we needed it sorted urgently. Dave was at the house the same morning and got us back up and running. He's been our go-to electrician for years now. Always reliable.
reviews.author: Robert H.
